In its fourth quarter of fiscal year 2017, Adobe achieved quarterly revenue of $2.01 billion, which represents 25 percent year-over-year growth.
In fiscal year 2017, Adobe achieved annual revenue of $7.30 billion, which also represents 25 percent year-over-year growth.
"Adobe delivered record revenue of $2 billion in Q4," said Shantanu Narayen, president and CEO, Adobe.
